description: Nebulento × Adapt fusion — precise keyword rules take the first shot, fuzzy matching mops up typos and ASR noise, and Adapt medium catches the remainder.
notes: HYPOTHESIS: does a strict keyword-rule engine (Adapt, low false-positive but brittle to phrasing/typos) at high confidence, backstopped by a fuzzy keyword matcher (Nebulento, tolerant of ASR noise and near-misses) at medium, and a lower-bar Adapt retry, beat either engine alone? Adapt and Nebulento are different matching strategies (strict rule vs fuzzy), so this tests real precision/recall complementarity, not a duplicate.
